note: Rustic state forest campground on Rock Lake in Pillsbury State Forest, managed from Crow Wing State Park. Day-use area beside it with a swimming beach, boat access to Rock Lake and nature trails. --Claude
summary: DNR facility record, map and fees page read: 44 primitive drive-in sites (15 lakeside, ~1/3 fit 30 ft), vault toilets, drinking water, $17 same-day pay, first come. Imagery puts the lakeside row under a continuous tree band: lakefront -> lakeview proposed. Website to the hyphen form; phone added; note cleaned.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed; default down): the DNR map puts sites 9-19 in a row between the campground road and the Rock Lake shore (the record says '15 are lakeside sites'). On NAIP and Esri imagery (the Esri tiles here are hazy) the road and its clearings (~46.4299,-94.4806) sit 30-70 m back from the waterline with a continuous band of tree canopy between, and no pad shows on open ground within ~50 m of the water. The stored evidence ('eastern row sites 8-19 set directly along Rock Lake shore') rests on the map, not on open ground. No campsite photos found to show otherwise.
